failure_modes.name: winch_tether_jam
failure_modes.symptoms: tether fails to deploy; winch stall; package not released; retrieval failure
failure_modes.mitigation: lubricate winch; inspect tether wear; pre-flight deploy/retract test; redundant release mechanism

failure_modes.name: droid_thruster_fault
failure_modes.symptoms: reduced ground thrust; uneven roll; thruster stall on slope; overheating
failure_modes.mitigation: clear thruster debris; motor-temp monitor; replace bearing; firmware derate

failure_modes.name: vtol_transition_failure
failure_modes.symptoms: failed transition to cruise; high drag; stall warning; unrecoverable attitude
failure_modes.mitigation: airspeed-gate checks; actuator inspection; enforce wind limits; redundant attitude sensor

failure_modes.name: daa_acoustic_false_alarm
failure_modes.symptoms: false collision alerts; unnecessary avoidance maneuvers; nuisance RTH; masks real threats
failure_modes.mitigation: sensor calibration; noise-filter tuning; environment noise map; cross-check with radar

failure_modes.name: energy_reserve_shortfall
failure_modes.symptoms: insufficient reserve for return; unexpected landing; range shrink; SOC misestimate
failure_modes.mitigation: conservative reserve margin; accurate SoC model; weather derate; abort logic

failure_modes.name: airframe_icing
failure_modes.symptoms: weight increase; reduced lift; vibration; rotor imbalance
failure_modes.mitigation: de-ice pre-flight; avoid icing conditions; heater elements; ground temp/humidity check
